text:
Galatasaray have confirmed that Super Eagles striker, Victor Osimhen has undergone successful surgery following a knee injury sustained during their UEFA Champions League match against VfB Stuttgart.
The Nigerian forward suffered a sprain in his left knee after the match, with an MRI scan subsequently revealing a free fragment in the affected area, prompting the need for surgery.
In a fresh statement yesterday morning, the Turkish Super Lig champions revealed that the operation was performed at Maslak Acıbadem Hospital by the club’s doctor, Yener Ince.
The Istanbul giants added that Osimhen’s condition would be monitored through daily assessments, while his treatment would continue under the supervision of the medical team.
Galatasaray also wished the 27-year-old a speedy recovery, expressing hope that he would return to action as soon as possible.
According to Turkish sports daily Fanatik, Osimhen is expected to miss the league matches against Amedspor and Samsunspor, with his recovery and rehabilitation estimated to take approximately three weeks.
Osimhen could make his return against Aston Villa on November 24, provided his rehabilitation goes according to plan.
Super Eagles coach, Eric Chelle, had hoped to have the former African Footballer of the Year available for the upcoming 2027, Africa Cup of Nations, Afcon qualifiers against Tanzania.
